info.summary: B4 tenant-protected PostgreSQL maintenance, insurance and operational evidence
info.description: Verified OIDC, FORCE RLS, versioned idempotent maintenance/insurance/operations writes. All policies, service records, location labels and readings are user-entered; no dispatch, insurer verification, GPS, Finance OS posting or live issuer/API staging is activated.
